text:
One year ago we had a big dream and a blank whiteboard. Looking back on our first year, I'm really proud of where we've ended up.

- $180K in revenue
- A team of 4 who show up every single day
- 17 paying customers in month 11, who believed in us before we had all the answers

The path wasn't a straight line, though. We had 2 failed pivots, and each one taught us something we couldn't have learned any other way. Every "not quite" got us closer to a "yes."

Three things this year taught me:
- Failure is data, not defeat.
- Small teams move fast when they move together.
- Customers are your compass. Listen more than you talk.

To everyone who took a chance on us: thank you, truly. 💙

On to year two.

What did your first year teach you? I'd like to hear in the comments.

#Startup #Founder #FirstYearInBusiness #Entrepreneurship #Growth #Gratitude
